property.name: recordId
property.label: Record Id
property.description: The Id of the parent record used to generate the email.

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: The API name of the parent object, such as Opportunity or Account.

property.name: templateId
property.label: Template Id
property.description: Optional template Id to preselect when launched from Flow.

property.name: flowMode
property.label: Flow Mode
property.description: Set to true when this component is used inside a Screen Flow.

property.name: hideFlowFooter
property.label: Hide Flow Footer
property.description: Set this with the Flow screen footer hidden so the component controls its own actions.

property.name: finishFlowOnSend
property.label: Finish Flow On Send
property.description: Finish the Flow automatically after a successful send.

property.name: emailSent
property.label: Email Sent
property.description: True when the email was sent successfully.

property.name: cancelled
property.label: Cancelled
property.description: True when the user cancelled the composer.
